sections.heading: Where AI Helps Today
sections.content: Common workflow steps where AI adds value: drafting, refining, classifying, extracting, translating and summarizing. The key is to keep a human in the loop for critical decisions.

sections.heading: Patterns
content: Draft → Review: AI prepares a first version; a human edits and approves
Extract → Structure: AI pulls facts from documents and outputs JSON/tables
Research → Synthesize: AI aggregates sources and compiles a brief with citations
Classify → Route: AI classifies tickets/emails and routes to the right team

sections.heading: Toolbox
content: LLM providers: ItemAI (LM Studio), OpenAI, OpenRouter
Orchestrators: n8n, AgentOps Studio, custom Node/Python
Stores: Vector DB (FAISS/Pinecone), Document DB, Object store
Messaging: Slack, email, webhooks for human-in-the-loop

sections.description: Use the AI Productivity Agent to turn a URL into a brief with next actions. Then copy the actions into your task system.
steps: Paste a news or blog URL
Generate the brief and top 5 next actions
Decide which actions are worth keeping; copy to your board
Reflect: what part still needs a human?
